# The routes of the fixture router, as "METHOD path".

# Declared and served: no violation.
GET /api/v1/things
# Declared, with a regular expression in the parameter chi routes by, braces and all: no
# violation.
GET /api/v1/things/{thing_id:[0-9]{1,8}}
# Served while still pending.
POST /api/v1/things
# Not declared: the contract has no PUT on this path.
PUT /api/v1/things/{thing_id}
# Served outside /api/v1, where no contract path can describe it.
GET /metrics
